career_spells.role: Design director and design strategy leader
career_spells.evidence_note: Professional and first-person profiles say Watson-Brown's practice merged with Architectus Brisbane in 2011, when she became design director, and that she later served as a design strategy leader after a national amalgamation. The Parliamentary Handbook records architectural work through 2021. Exact appointment and cessation dates, employing entity, hours and leave are not published. Employerpublication2March2017specificallycallsherDesignDirector. Nationalamalgamation/designstrategyleadertransitionstillundated; titledoesnotprovehours. The organiser program for Housing Futures on 26 July 2019 identifies her as Design Strategy Leader, Architectus Australia (Brisbane), presenting 443 Queen Street with the client representative. This establishes that later title by the event observation, without treating 26 July as appointment or amalgamation date. No second employer or additional paid interval is inferred. Contemporary11May2021profile reports she had recently retired from Architectus. This establishes retirement by that publication, but recently does not establish the actual last-paid date; structured end remains unknown pending employer/first-person terms.
career_spells.counting_note: Private employment is supported, but a full-time duration cannot be established.

career_spells.evidence_note: The Parliamentary Handbook records an adjunct professorship at the University of Queensland from 2009 to 2021, while UQ's current official profile and staff directory still list Watson-Brown as Adjunct Professor when retrieved on 3 October 2026. The official UQ policy states that honorary and adjunct title holders receive no remuneration from the University. The evidence does not establish uninterrupted title tenure after 2021, appointment workload or any separately paid work.
career_spells.counting_note: The adjunct title is an unpaid university affiliation under the current UQ policy and is excluded from headline public/private totals. The conflicting 2021 Handbook endpoint and current UQ listing preclude a continuous-duration claim.
